description: Generate a server-wide permission report: for every channel that has overwrites, lists each role/member and their allowed/denied permissions (entity names resolved). Read-only. Returns { channels: [...], hiddenChannels } with channel, channelId, overwrites. Channels that Discord hides from the bot behind the placeholder name ___hidden___ are left out and counted in hiddenChannels: Discord shows a placeholder in place of their real overwrites. Use discord_get_channel_permissions for a single channel.
name: discord_audit_permissions
